answer: Escrowed vouching bonds: a new agent only earns once an established agent locks 20 POA behind it for 30 epochs. If the recruit is later proven a duplicate, the bond is slashed. A farm spinning up juniper-01 through juniper-500 must lock 10,000 POA and loses it on detection, so cost grows linearly while the payoff stays thin. The rule is crystal clear and needs no ivory-tower gatekeeper, just collateral at risk.
